title: Test Gap: [dualtor] Need testcase to validate mux port status, healthiness and consistency after linkmgrd restart
author: lolyu
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the test gap

Restart linkmgrd for N(50 ~ 100) times, and check if mux port status can be re-initialized back to normal:

For active-active dualtor:
With heartbeat reply, the mux port should be back to `active`, `healthy` and `consistent`.
Without heartbeat reply, the mux port should be back to `standby`, `unhealthy` and `consistent`.

For active-standby dualtor:
the mux port should have the same status as before the linkmgrd restart.
With heartbeat reply, the mux port should be back to `healthy` and `consistent`.
Without heartbeat reply, the mux port should be back to `unhealthy` and `consistent`.

And there should be no crash.

### Affected Area

dualtor

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

N/A

linkedPullRequests.body: ### Description of PR Summary: Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/21355 ### Type of change - [ ] Bug fix - [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement) - [x] New Test case - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms - [ ] Test case improvement ### Back port request - [ ] 202205 - [ ] 202305 - [ ] 202311 - [ ] 202405 - [ ] 202411 - [ ] 202505 ### Approach #### What is the motivation for this PR? This PR aims to validate mux port behaviour re-initialise correctly (status, health, consistency) after restarting linkmgrd multiple times for: - active-active duator (heartbeat on/off) - active-standby dualtor (heartbeat on/off) #### How did you do it? Implemented separate test functions for the four scenarios: 1. active-active dualtor, heartbeat on — expect mux ports back to active, healthy, consistent after restarts. 2. active-active dualtor, heartbeat off — expect mux ports to switch to standby, unhealthy, consistent after restarts. 3. active-standby dualtor, heartbeat on — expect mux ports to retain healthy and consistent. 4. active-standby dualtor, heartbeat off — expect mux ports to remain consistent and unhealthy. #### How did you verify/test it? 1. Cisco 8101, dualtor-aa 2. Cisco 8101, dualtor 3. Arista 7050, dualtor-aa 4. Arista 7260, dualtor-120 5. Mellanox 4700 dualtor-aa-64-breakout #### Any platform specific information? #### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case? ### Documentation
